records.english: Game Overview{LB}Sail the world's oceans with your companions.{LB}The world has seven regions. You lead a faction based in one of them.{LB}Each region has rival factions. Trade and battle your way to mastery of all seven seas.{LB}{LB}{PAD}

Mysterious Token (Game Goal){LB}Rumor says a small item guides adventurers toward the Proof of Conquest. This item is known only as the Mysterious Token.{LB}No one yet knows its true nature or how it guides its owner.{LB}{LB}{PAD}
Lure fleets{LB}Draw a rival fleet to a chosen city in the current sea region.{LB}{LB}{PAD}
Bogus Documents{LB}Turn two rival factions against each other with forged orders. Select both targets.{LB}{LB}{PAD}
Bad Rumors{LB}Spread rumors in one city.{LB}This reduces a rival's local share.{LB}A weak strategist may not devise this plot.{LB}{LB}{PAD}
Bribery{LB}Bribe a broker to steal part of a rival's share. Choose one city in the current region.{LB}A weak strategist may not devise this plot.{LB}{LB}{PAD}
